rows.title: Commodity page and Commodity details wording, the Species column, the 'Select a commodity' error, the soft Save and return, and the error order match Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: The two live-animals commodity pages keep today's frame, today's server-side search and today's catalogue, and change what they say and how they save to Design Release 2.1's. The commodity page gets the ITAHC inset text, the live-animals search hint (common name, code or Latin name, with no 3-character sentence) and the Trade Tariff link's '(opens in a new tab)' on its own line. Its 'Select a commodity' error always sits on the search field, whether or not results are listed; 'Save and return to overview' saves the selection as it stands without checking it; and a selection made only of 01061900 species clears the unweaned animals answer, because that question is not asked for them. Commodity details gets the caption 'Description of the goods', a Species column in the Selected commodities table listing the Latin names chosen under each commodity, and an error summary that lists its errors by question, every number of animals error before any number of packages error. Every changed or added English string gets its Welsh counterpart, marked as a machine draft, so the Welsh pages do not fall behind.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's inset text reads 'You must submit a separate notification for every single ITAHC. You must also submit a notification for goods that do not need an ITAHC.' rows.title: Live-animal commodity catalogue matches Design Release 2.1, once commodities come from MDM
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1's live-animal catalogue: 0102 named 'Cattle' with 11 species, Horse with Donkey and Mule, 'Domestic cat' and 'Domestic dog', Ferret and Other live mammals on 01061900, Ornamental fish in place of Fish, and the poultry, livestock, rabbit, camel, ostrich, parrot, reptile and bee commodities. DR2.1's misspelt horse names and its duplicated 'Other mammal' entry are corrected rather than copied, because the species text reaches the receiving service as the scientific name. The number of packages question follows the new list. Ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon records this as work but blocks it until commodities come from MDM through trade-imports-reference-data, which serves no commodity list today; the area is re-distilled then, and the repos it builds in may change with that.

rows.title: Commodity search results sorted and bolded, and a selected panel of removable species chips, once commodities come from MDM
rows.detail: The server-rendered commodity page lists results alphabetically with the matched text in bold, and shows what has been chosen as one bold commodity line followed by a chip per species, by Latin name, each with its own remove button, so a trader can drop one choice without clearing everything. Ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon blocks these four until commodities come from MDM, then re-distils them. The rest of the old row (the error on the search field, the soft Save and return, clearing the unweaned answer) moved to the commodity wording row and goes ahead.

rows.title: Commodity search lists results as the trader types, with JavaScript, once design answers question 3 and commodities come from MDM
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 finds commodities as the trader types, behind an icon search button, keeps the typed text and the results open while species are ticked, closes them on Escape, and announces the result and selection counts in a polite live region. Ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon makes this design question 3: nothing new is built now, because today's server-side search with its Search button already works without JavaScript. When design answers, it is built as design says with an accepted component and no custom JavaScript copied from the prototype, or dropped if design drops it; it is also blocked on commodities coming from MDM.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, typing in the commodity search lists matching results as the trader types, with no Search press, behind an icon search button whose visually hidden text is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-078, prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-081; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-023; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-053, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-008)

Without JavaScript the page keeps the Search button, lists nothing for a query under 3 characters, and renders results and the selected panel on the server. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008, repo-frontend-p5-009, repo-frontend-p5-082; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p8-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067)

With JavaScript, pressing Escape closes the results and empties the search field, and the selection stays in the panel. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-044; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-057)

rows.title: Commodity pages chain as journey steps around the main import reason
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 makes the two commodity pages steps of the journey rather than an overview task that returns to the overview. The commodity page's back link goes to origin and Save and continue goes on to the main import reason; Commodity details comes after the main import reason, its back link goes to the commodity page, and Save and continue goes on to identification, additional or arrival details, whichever applies first. Opened from its overview task, each page still returns to the overview. The k6 performance suite's live-animals walk visits the main import reason between the two commodity pages in the same change, so the suite keeps running.
acceptanceCriteria: The commodity page's back link goes to the origin of the import page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-074; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-018, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-048)

After a valid choice on the commodity page, Save and continue goes to the main import reason page; opened from the overview it returns to the overview instead, and opened from check answers it returns to check answers. rows.notes: Unchanged in substance; ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-014) confirms it goes ahead on today's data. Combines the back-link slices (req-089, -108) with the next-step slices (req-087, -117, -118) and the k6 step-list slice (req-1761): the same journey flow change, observed only together, and the suite breaks the moment the order changes. c-015 (ruled): Design Release 2.1's chaining wins; opened from its overview task a page returns to the overview (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196). c-016: both pages keep the three return controls. c-018: the no-commodity redirect stays. c-225 (ruled): the performance suite changes in each increment whose change breaks one of its k6 scripts, on that increment's branch name; its 'Cow' search changes with the blocked catalogue row, not here. rows.title: Commodity pages return to where the trader came from: check answers, the overview or a template
rows.detail: A trader who opens the commodity pages from check answers, the overview or a template's review should come back there, not walk on through the journey. After a change from check answers, a valid Save and continue on both the commodity page and Commodity details returns to check answers, carried by the real service's change context; from the overview it returns to the overview; while editing a template from its review it returns to the template; and while creating a template a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the overview.
acceptanceCriteria: After choosing Change on a commodity answer from check answers, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to check answers. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-103)
Opened from the overview, a valid Save and continue on Commodity details returns to the overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)

While editing a template from its review, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page and on Commodity details returns to the template's review. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100)

While a trader is creating a template, a valid Save and continue on the commodity page goes to the notification overview. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-100; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-026, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-044)
rows.notes: Unchanged in substance: no requirement behind it moved, and ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-014) confirms it goes ahead. Combines the change-context return (req-119) with the template-creation return (req-091): both are where the commodity pages go back to, on the same two controllers. c-021 (ruled): Commodity details returns to check answers too, carried by ?change=1. Template mode walks the same commodity page as a notification and is animals only (templates ruling). Depends on inc-015 in this area, and on the templates area's rows that let a trader create a template and edit it from its review (inc-156, inc-159): the real service has no notification templates today, so the template criteria cannot be observed until those land.

rows.title: The live-animals commodity search offers no germinal products
rows.detail: Ruling 2026-10-09 gives germinal products their own set with its own catalogue, so the 12 germinal-product lines in today's live-animals catalogue come out of it: a trader on a live-animals notification is never offered semen, embryos or ova. Ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon lets this go ahead on today's data, because splitting today's lines between sets is set architecture, not list content, and moves it to the germinal set's go-ahead half of inc-016, where the germinal set's copy of today's commodity page takes those 12 lines.
acceptanceCriteria: On a live-animals notification, searching the commodity page for 'semen', 'embryos', 'ova' or the germinal codes 05111000 and 05119985 lists no results: the live-animals catalogue offers none of the 12 germinal-product lines it holds today. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-021; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-109)

On a live-animals notification, today's live-animal commodities (Cow, Horse, Cat, Dog and Fish) are still found and can still be chosen and saved. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-008, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-021)
rows.notes: Ruling 2026-10-09 afternoon (ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-008, -p2-021) moves req-1754 out of inc-012 (now blocked on MDM) to the germinal set's go-ahead half of inc-016, beside req-092, which states the same removal from the germinal side. The combiner should fold this row into that half of inc-016 (or whichever id the germinal-products area's split keeps for the go-ahead half), not keep it as a row of its own. c-222 (ruled): each set's catalogue holds only its own commodities. The code it changes is the live-animals commodity service, which the commodities-and-reason theme owns today, so placing it in germinal-products makes that theme touch the live-animals catalogue: the combiner must either give the live-animals catalogue change to the germinal-products theme for this row, or make germinal-products depend on commodities-and-reason; I followed the ruling's placement and left the boundary to the combiner. The tests repo's commodities spec lists today's catalogue and changes with it.

rows.title: Germinal Commodity details lists its errors by question, weight before packages
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 orders the Commodity details error summary by question. Ruling 2026-10-09 splits that per set; on the germinal set every total gross weight error comes before every number of packages error. The V4 germinal data fields make temperature optional, so temperature raises no error and never appears in the summary.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal-products notification, pressing Save and continue on Commodity details with errors on several species lists every Total gross weight error, species by species, before every Number of packages error, each linking to its own field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-051)

On a germinal-products notification, Temperature never appears in the Commodity details error summary, and Commodity details with no temperature chosen, a blank total gross weight and a valid number of packages for every species shows no error and saves. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; c-232)
rows.notes: req-1762 already sits in inc-177 (germinal Commodity details validation and error order), with the germinal-products area's weight and packages validation requirements; the combiner should keep it there and fold these two criteria into that row rather than keep a separate row. It is the germinal half of req-114, which the live-animals wording row (inc-011) builds. c-232 (ruled): the prototype's blank-weight and blank-temperature errors are not built. c-234 is ruled (packages are the line's quantity, at most 1,000), so inc-177's open question on it can become a note. Depends on the germinal Commodity details questions row (inc-017), which puts the fields on the page.

rows.title: The germinal Commodity details task shows Complete on valid packages, with weight and temperature optional
rows.detail: The overview task status tells the trader what is left to do. Ruling 2026-10-09 splits the Commodity details Complete rule per set; on the germinal set the V4 germinal data fields make the number of packages mandatory to proceed and total gross weight and temperature optional, so Design Release 2.1's bar of a weight above 0 and a temperature is not built.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal-products notification, the overview's Commodity details task shows Complete when every chosen species has a whole number of packages from 1 to 1,000, with total gross weight and temperature left blank. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-024, prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; c-232; c-234)

On a germinal-products notification, the overview's Commodity details task does not show Complete while any chosen species has no number of packages, or has a total gross weight entered that is not valid, such as 0. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-053)
On a germinal-products notification with no species chosen, the overview's Commodity details task does not show Complete. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-054)
rows.notes: req-1763 already sits in inc-099 (the germinal products Overview), because only that overview shows the task status; the combiner should keep it there, with these criteria replacing inc-099's three Commodity details Complete criteria (the packages limit now reads 1 to 1,000 under c-234's ruled outcome and req-1789). It is the germinal half of req-126, whose live-animals half exists. c-232 (ruled): weight and temperature do not hold the task back. Depends on the germinal Commodity details rows (inc-017, inc-177) for the stored fields and their validity.
